faq.a: Kemal is associated with the Arabic form كَمَال, whose core sense is kemal; perfection, completeness (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Kemal?
faq.a: Kemal is associated with Arabic. Kemal is the Turkish form of Arabic كَمَال (Kamāl), meaning 'perfection, completeness'.
Yes — the underlying form كَمَال is Arabic.
Kemal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kemal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Kamāl is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Kemal mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Kemal is rendered کمال and carries the sense کمال، کامل پن.

faq.q: What does Kemal mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Kemal is rendered کمال and carries the sense کمال، کمال.
A romanized syllable approximation is ke-mal. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Kemal?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Kemal, kemal. Script forms are كَمَال, کمال, कमाल.

faq.q: Is Kemal a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
